summary.headline: Cyient DET Q4 FY26 revenue $163.5M, down 2.4% QoQ in constant currency; INR720 crore buyback at INR1,125/share announced.
summary.overview: DET revenue fell 2.4% QoQ and 1.5% YoY in constant currency to $163.5M, as some client budget deployments shifted and West Asia energy deals slipped into later quarters. Normalized DET EBIT margin held at 12.4% and gross margin rose 114 bps QoQ to 38.9%. Management announced a buyback of up to 6.4M shares (5.76%) at INR1,125 per share for up to INR720 crore, and a planned fundraise at Cyient Semiconductor. The company also paused Project Astro, an acquisition, and took a INR71 crore exceptional diligence charge.

segments.name: DET (Digital Engineering & Technology, excl. semiconductor)
segments.commentary: Q4 revenue $163.5M, -2.4% QoQ cc; normalized EBIT 12.4%. H2 order intake grew 5.5% YoY and Q4 order intake grew 23% YoY per management.

segments.name: Transportation & Mobility cluster
segments.commentary: Grew 4.5% QoQ in Q4 and 13.2% YoY in cc for FY26, led by aerospace.

segments.name: Network & Infrastructure
segments.commentary: Declined 3.6% QoQ in Q4 and 1.6% YoY for FY26; management expects fiber build-out spend to be sustained for 3-5 years.

segments.name: Strategic units
segments.commentary: Degrowth of 12.4% QoQ in Q4 and 12.2% for FY26; management targets roughly flat QoQ in Q1 FY27.

segments.name: Cyient DLM (listed subsidiary)
segments.commentary: FY26 book-to-bill 1.5x, highest order book in its history per management, and 10.3% profitability for the year.

segments.name: Cyient Semiconductor
segments.commentary: Q4 revenue $7.2M (+5% QoQ, fourth straight QoQ rise); FY26 revenue $25.7M; Q4 EBIT -$2.8M. Kinetic Technologies 74% stake closed; management targets about $100M revenue in FY27 with negative margins.

guidance_outlook: FY27 organic growth aspiration: mid-to-high single digit YoY.
EBIT margin target of about 15% by Q4 FY27 (management equates this to roughly 17-17.5% EBITDA); margin levers are price hikes, automation/AI, and admin cost cuts.
Q1 FY27 to see continued West Asia energy deal impact; strategic units aimed at roughly flat QoQ.
Dividend policy of 40-50% payout maintained, now via dividend plus buyback; INR16 interim dividend treated as final.
Buyback expected to lift EPS growth in FY27, subject to shareholder approval.
Semiconductor breakeven targeted toward end FY26 / early FY27; first equity raise of about 10-12% of Cyient Semiconductor equity, with debt also contemplated.
capex_capacity: Buyback: up to 6.4M shares (5.76% of paid-up capital) via tender offer at INR1,125/share, aggregate up to INR720 crore; promoters and KMP not participating; subject to shareholder approval.
Project Astro (large transformative DET acquisition) paused, not abandoned; INR71 crore exceptional diligence charge in Q4; marginal cost if revived is small.
Cyient Semiconductor: Board agreed in principle to raise debt and equity; engaging bankers; first raise small, about 10-12% dilution.
Semiconductor fab modernization program won from SCIL (MeitY-backed), expected to start late Q1 or early Q2 FY27.
Kinetic Technologies 74% majority stake closed; focus on power silicon and ASSP portfolio.
demand_pricing: Q4 slippage attributed mainly to three key customers delaying program starts and shifts in budget deployment; management says not a pipeline conversion issue.
Typically about 75% of converted order book is consumed within the first 9 months, per management.
Some existing customers accepted price increases in FY26.
Direct West Asia exposure described as not significant; energy exposure is mainly project-based via Tier 1 EPC firms.
Large deals in pipeline now present in 5 or 6 of 7 market segments, led by connectivity and healthcare.

qa_highlights.question: How much DET revenue is exposed to West Asia, and what headwind over the next few quarters?
qa_highlights.answer: Direct exposure is not significant; exposure is project-based via Tier 1 EPC and energy firms, and the slipped deals were in the Middle East pipeline. No exact figure given.

qa_highlights.question: What is the Project Astro asset and vertical?
qa_highlights.answer: Krishna declined to give specifics, citing NDAs; described it only as a very big transformative acquisition.

qa_highlights.question: How much dilution for the semiconductor fundraise and how do buyback and raise reconcile?
qa_highlights.answer: First raise about 10-12% dilution, small; buyback is for Cyient, raise is to establish independent value for Cyient Semiconductor and avoid penalizing Cyient shareholders with its losses.

qa_highlights.question: Will strategic units keep degrowing in Q1, and will delayed programs return?
qa_highlights.answer: Connectivity delays are already in execution but capacity-limited, so work shifts rather than being lost. Target is roughly flat for Q1; energy/West Asia timing uncertain.

qa_highlights.question: FY27 outlook for semiconductor and margin path to 15% EBIT?
qa_highlights.answer: Semiconductor FY27 revenue about $100M with negative margins; 15% EBIT by Q4 FY27 target maintained, with price hikes, automation and admin cost cuts as levers, though geopolitics add volatility.

qa_highlights.question: Why has EBITDA margin fallen from about 18% in FY24, and when will margins recover?
qa_highlights.answer: Management clarified the 16% peak was EBIT in Q4 FY24; the target is 15% EBIT by Q4 FY27, which equals roughly 17-17.5% EBITDA.

qa_highlights.question: Which part of the business is most at risk from AI?
qa_highlights.answer: Management sees AI threat as minimal overall; software development is a small portion where 20-30% productivity gains are seen; data and life cycle services seen as opportunities.

risks_watch: West Asia energy deal delays expected to persist into Q1 FY27; energy is project-based and volatile.
Strategic units degrowth of 12.2% for FY26; recovery to flat QoQ in Q1 is a target, not yet proven.
Cyient Semiconductor FY27 margins negative; fundraise size, valuation and dilution still open.
Project Astro paused; scope for revival and related cost remain open.
AI-driven pricing pressure in software development; 20-30% productivity gains could compress revenue on some work.
Group EBIT margin down 254 bps to 9.5%; margin path depends on pricing, cost actions and currency.
Leadership transition: new CFO Shrinivas Kulkarni and COO Prabhakar Atla from April 1, 2026.
summary.management_tone: Confident on the medium-term outlook and capital returns, but cautious and somewhat evasive on Q4 shortfall drivers, timing of Q1 recovery and Project Astro details. Management stressed that the slippage was temporary and not structural.
key_quotes: I want also to categorically communicate that these were not structural to the business demand or our value proposition in the market.
We won't dilute more than maybe 10 -12% of the equity to start with.

It will be among the largest buybacks in the tech sector, and that's because our Board is very confident that while we have a lot of investment opportunities, we also have a lot of avenues for cash generation.

financial_highlights.change: -2.4% QoQ cc; -1.5% YoY cc; +0.8% QoQ INR; +7.4% YoY INR

adds.what: Semiconductor fab modernization program won from SCIL (MeitY-backed)

growth.why: Management aspires to mid-to-high single-digit DET organic growth in FY27 (midpoint ~6%), backed by Q4 order intake up 23% YoY and H2 order intake up 5.5% YoY, price increases and a 15% EBIT margin target by Q4 FY27 via pricing, automation and admin cost cuts; no specific new capacity is added and the Q4 slippage weighs on near-term delivery.
